interpretations: Per-day rate definition:
Per-day rate = average over a rating's films of (rental_rate / rental_duration), the average of per-film ratios.
Per-day rate = a rating's average rental_rate divided by its average rental_duration, the ratio of averages.
Per-day rate = a rating's total rental_rate divided by its total rental_duration, the ratio of sums.
Cross-rating average definition:
The cross-rating average is the unweighted mean of the 5 rating-level per-day rates.
The cross-rating average is the mean per-day rate over all films, so ratings with more films count more.
The cross-rating average is the ratio of the overall average rental_rate to the overall average rental_duration across all films.
Comparison and output:
Ratings qualify if their per-day rate is strictly above the cross-rating average, and ties are excluded.
Ratings qualify if their per-day rate is at or above the cross-rating average.

The single row gives the mean of the qualifying ratings' rating-level average replacement costs, the mean of their rating-level per-day rates, and the mean of their excesses (rating rate minus cross-rating average), all as unweighted means across the qualifying ratings.

The single row pools all films in the qualifying ratings: average replacement cost over those films, average per-film per-day rate over those films, and the average per-film excess over the cross-rating average.
The single row gives the qualifying ratings' average replacement cost weighted by film count, with the per-day rate and excess computed as unweighted means across ratings.
"How far above" is an absolute difference in dollars per day (rating rate minus cross-rating average).
"How far above" is a relative or percentage difference (rating rate divided by cross-rating average, minus 1).
"On average how far above" is the average excess across the qualifying ratings, which equals the average per-day rate minus the cross-rating average.
"On average how far above" is the average over individual films in the qualifying ratings of (film per-day rate minus cross-rating average).
No rounding is applied to any value, so full-precision numbers are returned.
The qualifying ratings are also listed individually, with the single summary row presented alongside the rating names.
queries: SELECT title, rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration AS per_day_rate FROM film;
SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating
SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating
SELECT rating, SUM(rental_rate) / SUM(rental_duration) AS per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating
SELECT AVG(avg_length) FROM (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating);
